problem: System 9 remained PARTIAL because its local exercise intentionally packages but does not build an OCI image. The same exact source head already has a successful hosted OCI job whose committed proof gates require two identical independent image builds and six container-versus-host case matches. Completion must reconcile that stronger evidence without claiming access to uninspected artifact internals or converting sandbox success into real-world authority.

alternatives.name: Bounded evidence reconciliation
alternatives.mechanism: Retain the local deterministic context exercise; bind exact-head hosted run and job metadata plus source hashes and committed proof gates; mark only system 9 COMPLETE at SANDBOX_VERIFIED; preserve all former gap text, negative evidence, limitations, and explicit recovery.

alternatives.name: PARTIAL despite hosted proof
alternatives.mechanism: Keep the existing row and require a future machine-local Docker build before any status change.

alternatives.name: Do nothing
alternatives.mechanism: Make no repository change and leave the hosted success as coordination-page prose only.

alternatives.name: Link the green job
alternatives.mechanism: Change PARTIAL to COMPLETE and link the successful workflow run without a structured evidence record or boundary review.

alternatives.name: Require independent artifact and log reinspection
alternatives.mechanism: Keep PARTIAL until a reviewer downloads and inspects report.json, both OCI layouts, per-case outputs, and raw logs, or commissions a fresh independent proof with readable evidence.

alternatives.name: Local scoped commit and child draft
alternatives.mechanism: Commit only the evidence, row, and deliberation changes; rerun the OCI suite, full Foundry audit, and completion-contract suite; stage a child draft into pull 196 and let the integrator decide whether the evidence boundary is sufficient.

review_roles.review: The change performs safe buildable gap closure while leaving merge, activation, VEPMC, and real-world consequence decisions with the founder.
The exact base, current destination head, implementation, proof workflow, tests, and completion enforcement were inspected before editing.
A successful platform job is not equivalent to inspecting its artifact or raw logs. Completion is therefore explicitly bounded and not called independent case-level verification.
Any reproduction mismatch, later source drift, or hosted-evidence contradiction must restore PARTIAL; retained negative evidence and the former gap are not deleted.
Only completion metadata and documents change. No runtime, organ, workflow, authority, or privileged execution path is introduced.

independence_note: These are five required self-review roles, not five independent reviewers. Independent human or separate-model review remains pending.

attacks.disadvantage: The artifact archive could not be downloaded (401), so report.json and OCI layouts were not independently inspected.
Raw job logs require repository admin rights (403); the public page requires sign-in.
Overall canonical CI on the base was not all green because job 1 was cancelled after its timeout.
A broad COMPLETE label could be misread as full-machine OCI execution or system 10 completion.
The local sandbox mount reports st_nlink 0 for owned files, so signed GREG OCI tests refuse them there.
Marking the row COMPLETE makes every later full audit rerun the packaging exercise; missing dependencies could obscure the actual result.

strengthening_passes.candidate_after_pass: Retain the hosted-evidence reconciliation only with structured provenance, explicit evidence-tier and non-claims, native-filesystem validation, and full reproduction.

dispositions.resolution: Record the artifact ID, digest, size, expiry, retrieval failure, and not_independently_reinspected=true. Do not claim artifact contents or an image digest from the archive digest. Stronger evidence still requires the strongest-competitor path.
Record the 403 and sign-in boundary. Treat exact run/job/step conclusions as hosted execution metadata, not raw-log review.
Set all_canonical_ci_green=false and preserve the cancelled job. Claim only the separate successful OCI job and proof step.
Bind completion to the restricted-rule OCI capability at SANDBOX_VERIFIED; retain the full former gap and name system 10, privileged execution, portability, and deployment as open.
Preserve the mount refusal as an environmental limitation and verify the exact tree on a native filesystem; do not weaken the unlinked-file guard.
Record the new local evidence only after the row supports the required schema, then run the complete 55-system audit and the dedicated positive/negative contract tests on the exact committed tree.

strengthening_passes.material_dissent_retained: A green platform result plus immutable artifact metadata is weaker than independent case-level report inspection. The strongest competitor remains valid for any claim beyond SANDBOX_VERIFIED. No pass-1 disadvantage was silently dropped.

Initial audit attempts stopped on unavailable declared dependencies (rfc3161_client, wasmtime, imageio_ffmpeg, stripe, claude_agent_sdk) and one incompatible Pillow interpreter path; these were environmental stops, not passing evidence.
Large SDK wheel and combined dependency installation attempts timed out and were not used; only hash-checked declared packages were used for the final audit.

Two commissioning reproduction attempts failed with KeyError proposal because target-only pytest was invisible to the intentionally scrubbed child CI. A native virtual environment with normal .pth dependency visibility fixed the environment without changing scrubbing or project code; focused system 51 then matched its retained result hash.
The successful audit and 66-test suite are local exact-tree evidence, not hosted child-head CI, an entire-repository test run, integration, deployment, or independent review.

dissent.position: Do not treat this as independent verification of every hosted case or as sufficient evidence for real-world OCI portability.
dissent.resolution_threshold: A reviewer must inspect the immutable artifact and raw logs, or a fresh independently commissioned proof must expose equivalent case-level evidence, before upgrading the evidence tier.
dissent.review_trigger: Artifact access becomes available; any source hash or hosted conclusion changes; any audit mismatch occurs; or scope expands beyond the restricted-rule capability.

rollback: Revert the scoped child commit or restore only system 9 to PARTIAL while retaining the evidence and deliberation documents. No runtime migration or external effect needs undoing.
